reader.requirement: At --std 85, when FUNCTION MIN has more than one argument-1 all must be of one class (numeric, or alphabetic/alphanumeric mixed, the 1985 alphanumeric class holding numeric-edited, alphanumeric-edited and group items per §1985:IV.4.3.3), so a numeric argument beside an alphabetic or alphanumeric one is refused and same-class lists are accepted.

edition-consulted.switches: ArgPredicate.AppliesAt(edition year) for the MIN row's NotStrongGroup predicate (Since default 85, so applied at every edition; inert at 85 where no strongly-typed group can be declared)

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs (Since/Edition/Version/1985) and IntrinsicBinder.cs (IsAvailable/DialectLevel/Edition.Edition/AppliesAt): CrossViolation, CrossBlock and the class lattice consult no edition; the 2023-only legs of the row (boolean/pointer/object exclusions, zero-length literal) cannot be reached by 85 source.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the same cross-class screen runs at 85 and 2023

reader.notes: CrossViolation intersects each argument's Table-2 class (TableTwoClass projects numeric-edited to alphanumeric) after CrossBlock merges alphabetic into alphanumeric, which is the amended (X3.23b-1993) 1985 rule exactly; groups and ref-modified items are class alphanumeric as §1985:IV.4.3.3 has them. Every same-class list ran with the right least value and every mixed list was refused. The diagnostic names §2023:15.63.3 r2, not the 1985 rule.
reader.at-2023: same COBOL1627 refusals at --std 2023 for min_bad.cob

refuter.evidence: Attacked the amended (X3.23b-1993) rule's operand classes the reader did not probe. Accepts at --std 85: zero_min.cob MIN(N1 ZERO 4) printed 0 and MIN(ZEROS + 3, N1) printed 3 (ZERO as a numeric arithmetic expression); tab2.cob MIN(C(ALL ALL)) printed -8, MIN(FUNCTION CHAR(66) X5 A3) printed 'A' (alphanumeric function beside alphanumeric and alphabetic items, size of the selected argument per RV3), MIN(FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(A3) X5) printed BAT; min_mix.cob MIN(A3 ED) with ED PIC ZZ9 printed ' 42' and MIN(ED A3(1:2) N1(2:2)) printed ' 42' (alphabetic, numeric-edited and ref-modified items all alphanumeric-compatible). Refusals: bad_tbl.cob MIN(NE(ALL) X5), MIN(XE(ALL) N1), MIN(G(ALL) N1) each refused COBOL1627 (class mix reached through ALL); later_lit.cob MIN(X5 N"AB") and MIN(X5 B"1") refused COBOL0900 plus COBOL1627. fig_min.cob: MIN(X5 SPACE), MIN(X5 ZERO), MIN(X5 HIGH-VALUE) accepted and printed the one-character figurative value; §1989:A.2.2 AR3 names only data items and nonnumeric literals, so a figurative constant there is a reading, not a decisive violation of this rule. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.27.3 AR1 (the text is in AR1, amended text 'mixing of arguments of alphabetic and alphanumeric classes is allowed'); OK §1985:VI.6.2.1.
